notes: Hotfix - chuyen section trong workspace Quan ly (sidebar ?section=...) luon nhay ve dau trang. Root cause: updateManagerSectionView() (assets/js/checklist/phf-checklist-app.js) goi cung try{content.scrollTop=0;window.scrollTo(0,0);}catch(_e){} khong dieu kien moi lan doi noi dung [data-phfck-manager-content], khong doc lai vi tri cuon truoc do - khac voi updateAdminView() (cung file) da dung dung pendingScrollRestore de giu cuon cho admin. Sua toi thieu, tai dung co che pendingScrollRestore/restoreScroll() da co san: (1) click menu data-phfck-manager-section bay gio set pendingScrollRestore=currentScrollY() truoc khi pushState+render (dung mau admin dang dung); (2) updateManagerSectionView() doc pendingScrollRestore ngay khi vao ham (truoc khi content.innerHTML thay doi) - neu co gia tri thi goi restoreScroll(restoreY) sau khi noi dung moi da render, neu null (F5/deep-link lan dau, Back/Forward qua popstate khong set bien nay) thi GIU NGUYEN hanh vi cu (scrollTop=0) khong doi - Back/Forward va F5 khong regress vi khong dung toi nhanh moi; (3) restoreScroll() them clamp max theo document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight (truoc chi clamp min 0) de trang moi ngan hon khong bi cuon qua da/blank - ap dung chung cho moi noi dang goi ham nay (updateAdminView, renderViolationWorkspace, rerenderKeepingScroll), khong chi rieng Quan ly. Khong luu scroll theo localStorage, khong giu qua logout/login (pendingScrollRestore la bien phien lam viec, reset ve null ngay sau khi doc), khong dung setTimeout do doan (dung dung requestAnimationFrame long da co trong restoreScroll). Khong sua router/backend/API/permission, khong dung den modal/dropdown/target picker, khong ap dung ngoai Checklist. Khong co test suite tu dong cho hanh vi scroll trinh duyet (khong co browser/DOM test trong repo) - da doc code xac nhan tung nhanh Back/Forward/F5/logout khong bi dung toi nhanh moi, nhung click-through browser that van can nguoi dung xac nhan truc quan. Toan bo 16 script checklist hien co (khong lien quan scroll) chay lai sach, khong regress.
